contract.isValid.question: Is the contract valid?
contract.isValid.condition: A contract is valid if it has a non-compete clause and is signed by both parties

contract.hasNonCompete.description: Whether the contract includes a non-compete clause

contract.isSignedByBothParties.description: Whether the contract is signed by both parties

contract.isSignedByBothParties.question: Is the contract signed by both parties?
contract.isSignedByBothParties.condition: A contract is signed by both parties if party A and party B both signed

contract.signedByPartyA.description: Whether party A signed the contract

contract.signedByPartyB.description: Whether party B signed the contract
